mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, source_run_id, continue_run_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, runtime_provider, runtime_binding_id, runtime_session_id, approval_id, interaction_type, status, request_payload_json, response_payload_json, expires_at, answered_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t( id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, source_run_id, continue_run_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, runtime_provider, runtime_binding_id, runtime_session_id, approval_id, interaction_type, status, request_payload_json, response_payload_json, expires_at, answered_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{sourceRunId}, #{continueRunId}, #{userMessageId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{runtimeProvider}, #{runtimeBindingId}, #{runtimeSessionId}, #{approvalId}, #{interactionType}, #{status}, #{requestPayloadJson}, #{responsePayloadJson}, #{expiresAt}, #{answeredAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.user_id, i.session_id, i.source_run_id, i.continue_run_id, i.user_message_id, i.assistant_message_id, i.runtime_provider, i.runtime_binding_id, i.runtime_session_id, i.approval_id, i.interaction_type, i.status, i.request_payload_json, i.response_payload_json, i.expires_at, i.answered_at, i.cancelled_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i JOIN fin_ex_chat_run_t r ON r.id = i.continue_run_id AND r.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND r.user_id = i.user_id AND r.session_id = i.session_id WHERE i.status = 'RESPONDING' AND r.status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY i.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.user_id, i.session_id, i.source_run_id, i.continue_run_id, i.user_message_id, i.assistant_message_id, i.runtime_provider, i.runtime_binding_id, i.runtime_session_id, i.approval_id, i.interaction_type, i.status, i.request_payload_json, i.response_payload_json, i.expires_at, i.answered_at, i.cancelled_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at, CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_RUN' WHEN r.status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN' ELSE 'MISSING_EXECUTION' END AS reconcile_state FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i LEFT JOIN fin_ex_chat_run_t r ON r.id = i.continue_run_id AND r.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND r.user_id = i.user_id AND r.session_id = i.session_id LEFT JOIN fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.user_id = r.user_id AND e.session_id = r.session_id WHERE i.status = 'RESPONDING' AND ( r.status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') OR ( i.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND ( r.id IS NULL OR (r.status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND r.first_seq IS NULL AND r.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND e.run_id IS NULL) ) ) ) ORDER BY i.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i SET status = 'WAITING', continue_run_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.id = #{interactionId} AND i.status = 'RESPONDING' AND i.continue_run_id = #{continueRunId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.id = i.continue_run_id AND r.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND r.user_id = i.user_id AND r.session_id = i.session_id AND r.status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ) OR ( i.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.id = i.continue_run_id AND r.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND r.user_id = i.user_id AND r.session_id = i.session_id ) ) )
